z-m-10-05.title: Indlela esheshayo yokuthola umjikelezo ihlala isebenza?
z-m-10-05.topic: Umjikelezo wezimo ezenziwe ngezikwele zegridi, nemikhawulo yendlela elula
z-m-10-05.goal: Hlola ngezibonelo ukuthi yimaphi amasimo indlela elula yokuthola umjikelezo wesimo kusukela emjikelezweni we-rectangle ezungezile ilungile futhi yimaphi engalungile, futhi uchaze imibandela lapho ibamba khona ngezimfanelo zesimo.
z-m-10-05.material:
Isikwele esisodwa segridi sisikwele esinezinhlangothi ezingu-1 cm. Izimo ezingezansi zenziwe ngokujoyina izikwele zegridi ohlangothini nohlangothi, futhi azinazo izimbobo ngaphakathi. Umjikelezo wesimo ubude bonke bomugqa womngcele wangaphandle, futhi uhlanganisa nomngcele wezingxenye ezingeniswe ngaphakathi. ■ isikwele sesimo, □ isikwele esingenalutho, futhi imigqa ifundwa kusukela phezulu.
Isimo 가: umugqa 1 ■□ / umugqa 2 ■□ / umugqa 3 ■■
Isimo 나: umugqa 1 ■■■ / umugqa 2 □■□
Isimo 다: umugqa 1 ■□■ / umugqa 2 ■■■
Isimo 라: umugqa 1 □■□ / umugqa 2 ■■■ / umugqa 3 □■□
Isimo 마: umugqa 1 ■□■ / umugqa 2 ■□■ / umugqa 3 ■■■
Jiho: 'Uma uthola umjikelezo we-rectangle encane kakhulu esonga isimo (ifaniswe nemigqa yegridi), ufana nomjikelezo wesimo. Ungawuthola ngokushesha!' Harin: 'Ngibala imiphetho engu-1 cm yomngcele wangaphandle eyodwa ngeyodwa. Kuthatha isikhathi, kodwa kuqinisekile.'
z-m-10-05.thinking.1: Ukuthola izimo lapho isebenza khona nezibonelo eziphikisayo
z-m-10-05.prereq.0: Ukwazi ubude bomjikelezo kusukela ebudeni bomugqa wangaphandle womumo uma isikwele esisodwa segridi singu-1 cm (izinga lamaBanga 3-4)
z-m-10-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha yonke imimumo lapho inani elitholwe ngendlela kaJiho (ubude bomjikelezo be-rectangle ezungezile) lifana nenani elibaliwe ngendlela kaHarin (ubude bomjikelezo bangempela).

z-m-10-05.s.s1.hint.1: Emkhawulweni wangaphandle womumo ngamunye, bala imiphetho engu-1 cm ngokuhlukile ngesiqondiso: phezulu, kwesokudla, ezansi, nakwesobunxele.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.r.a: Uma uphutheke umumo 가: ukubala imiphetho emifushane yomkhawulo kunika u-10 cm, futhi ubude bomjikelezo be-rectangle ezungezile (amasikwele angu-2 aphesheya, amasikwele angu-3 aphansi) nabo bungu-10 cm.

z-m-10-05.s.s1.r.c: Uma ukhethe umumo 다: i-rectangle ezungezile inamasikwele angu-3 aphesheya namasikwele angu-2 aphansi, ngakho ubude bomjikelezo wayo bungu-10 cm, kodwa uma ubala nezindonga nenhlabathi yomsele maphakathi, ubude bomjikelezo bangempela bungu-12 cm.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.r.d: Uma uphutheke umumo 라: umkhawulo ungu-12 cm, futhi ubude bomjikelezo be-rectangle ezungezile (amasikwele angu-3 aphesheya, amasikwele angu-3 aphansi) nabo bungu-12 cm.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.r.e: Uma ukhethe umumo 마: i-rectangle ezungezile inamasikwele angu-3 aphesheya namasikwele angu-3 aphansi, ngakho ungu-12 cm, kodwa umsele ujulile, ngakho ubude bomjikelezo bangempela bungu-16 cm.
z-m-10-05.s.s1.explain: Ubude bomjikelezo bangempela nobude bomjikelezo be-rectangle ezungezile bungu-10 cm no-10 cm kumumo 가, 10 cm no-10 cm kumumo 나, 12 cm no-10 cm kumumo 다, 12 cm no-12 cm kumumo 라, no-16 cm no-12 cm kumumo 마. Lezo ezifanayo ziyi-가, 나 no-라. Ku-다 no-마, enomsele ongene ngaphakathi, inani likaJiho lincane kunelangempela.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.prompt: Cabanga nge-rectangle enamangqamuzana angu-w aphesheya namangqamuzana angu-h aphansi, enomsele obanzi ngeqamuzana e-1 nojule ngamaqamuzana angu-d osikiwe endaweni eyodwa emgqeni ophezulu ongekho kunoma yimuphi umkhawulo. Umsele awufinyeleli onqenqemeni olungezansi, futhi okungenani umugqa o-1 usala ngaphansi kwawo. Isibonelo, kukhona umumo onu-(w=3, h=2, d=1) kanye nomumo onu-(w=3, h=3, d=2). Thola imimumo emithathu enama-w, h, d ahlukile obude bomkhawulo wangaphandle (ubude bomjikelezo) bungu-18 cm.

z-m-10-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Umsele ufinyelela onqenqemeni olungezansi. Ukujula komsele kumele kube okungenani u-1 ngaphansi kwenani lamasikwele aphansi.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Ubude bomjikelezo abusilo u-18 cm. Qhathanisa nobude bomjikelezo be-rectangle engenaso isisele bese usebenza ukuthi umsele ukhulisa ubude bomjikelezo kangakanani.
z-m-10-05.s.s2.explain: Uma usika umsele, ubude bomjikelezo bungubude bomjikelezo be-rectangle engenaso isisele, 2×(w+h), kanye nobude bezindonga ezimbili zomsele, 2×d. Amacala angu-18 cm angu-(w, h, d) = (3, 4, 2), (3, 5, 1), (4, 3, 2), (4, 4, 1), (5, 3, 1), (6, 2, 1).

z-m-10-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Uchaze ngokuqondile umehluko wemumo phakathi kwemiumo lapho isebenza khona (가, 나, 라) nemiumo lapho ingasebenzi khona (다, 마), njengo-"umsele ovaliwe ezinhlangothini zombili"?

z-m-10-03.title: Inani elingakanani lama-diagonal elinawo i-polygon?
z-m-10-03.goal: Zwa ukuthi ukuqagela okwenziwe ngedatha encane kulungiswa kanjani ngedatha entsha, futhi uxhumanise inani lama-diagonal avela ku-vertex eyodwa nenani eliphelele lama-diagonal ukuze uhlole nesizathu somthetho.
z-m-10-03.material: I-diagonal iyingxenye yomugqa exhuma ama-vertex amabili e-polygon angeseduze komunye. Lo msebenzi ucabangela kuphela ama-polygon angenazo izimpawu zangaphakathi. I-quadrilateral inezinhlangothi ezi-4, i-pentagon inezinhlangothi ezi-5, i-hexagon inezinhlangothi ezi-6, ne-heptagon inezinhlangothi ezi-7. Asikho isithombe esibonisiwe, ngakho zizwe ukuzidweba wena ephepheni.
z-m-10-03.thinking.1: Ukuhlulela ukuthi idatha entsha ishintsha noma iqinisa ukuqagela
z-m-10-03.prereq.0: Incazelo ye-diagonal namagama i-quadrilateral, i-pentagon, ne-hexagon (izinga leBanga 4)
z-m-10-03.prereq.1: Ukubhala inani lezinhlangothi nenani etafuleni eceleni komunye ukuze uqhathanise

z-m-10-03.s.s1.hint.0: Uma ungadweba, qamba ama-vertex, uxhumanise amaphoyinti amabili angeseduze komunye, futhi urekhode lokho obalile etafuleni.

z-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.info: I-diagonal iyingxenye yomugqa exhuma ama-vertex amabili angeseduze komunye. Ama-polygon angenazo izimpawu zangaphakathi kuphela acatshangelwayo. Qamba ama-vertex ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ futhi uwadwebe wena. Uma ngidweba futhi ngibala, i-quadrilateral yayinama-diagonal angu-2 ne-pentagon yayinama-diagonal angu-5.

z-m-10-03.s.s1.reflect: "Kukhuphuka ngo-3 ngasikhathi sinye" wokuqala walungiswa idatha ye-hexagon, futhi u-14 we-heptagon waqinisekiswa kokubili njengeqagelo elisekelwe emthethweni nangesizathu. Hlukanisa ukuthi iyiphi idatha eshintshe ukuqagela nokuthi iyiphi iqinise.

z-m-10-02.title: Lapho imiumo ihlangana endaweni eyodwa, kuzosala isikhala noma kuzodlulana?
z-m-10-02.goal: Usebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi uma amaphoyinti emiumo eqoqwa endaweni eyodwa, ama-engela kumele ahlanganise ukujikeleza okuphelele kokukodwa (360°) ukuze kungabi nasikhala futhi kungadlulani, hlulela ngokuqhathanisa usayizi wesikhala ne-engela eyodwa yomumo, bese wenza wena izixazululo eziningana.
z-m-10-02.material: I-engela eyodwa kanxantathu olinganayo, isikwele, nomumo onezinhlangothi eziyisi-6 olinganayo ingu-60°, 90°, no-120° ngokulandelana. Uma uqoqa amaphoyinti emiumo eminingana endaweni eyodwa, uma wonke ama-engela azungeze leyo ndawo ehlangana angu-360° (ukujikeleza okuphelele kukodwa), afaneleka ngqo ngaphandle kwesikhala nokudlulana. Uma isamba singaphansi kuka-360°, kushiywa isikhala, futhi uma singaphezu kuka-360°, imiumo iyadlulana. Nakuba zonke izinhlangothi ezine zilingana ku-5 cm, amakhoneni angu-60° no-120°, ngakho akuyona i-polygon ejwayelekile. I-rectangle iyisibonelo esiphikisayo sesitatimende sikaRoha. Nakuba wonke amakhoneni amane alingana ku-90°, ububanzi bungu-3 cm nobude bungu-5 cm, ngakho akuyona i-polygon ejwayelekile. Ngakho kokubili ubude bezinhlangothi nosayizi bamakhoneni kumele kulingane ukuze ibe yi-polygon ejwayelekile.
z-m-10-04.s.s3.model.1: Ungadweba i-rhombus enezinhlangothi zonke ezilinganayo kodwa engeyona isikwele, futhi ungadweba i-rectangle enamakhoneni wonke alinganayo kodwa engeyona isikwele. Ngakho i-polygon ejwayelekile idinga izinhlangothi ezilinganayo namakhoneni alinganayo.
z-m-10-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Impendulo ebhalwe ngamagama ezimo kuphela, ngaphandle kwezinombolo, nayo ilungile uma isibonelo esiphikisayo sicacile.
